protocol.name: BabyLM 2026 Strict causal zero-shot COMPS + entity tracking

protocol.aggregation: COMPS: macro-average over the four subsets. Entity tracking: mean over per-numops UIDs within each of regular/ambiref/move_contents, then mean of the three splits.
